entities.summary: Aslanbek Shymbergenov is a Kazakh boxer. He won the gold medal in the light middleweight event at the 2023 IBA World Boxing Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. He won the silver medal in the men's 69 kg event at the 2018 Asian Games held in Indonesia.
